premise: On a windy night Tree sorts out who sleeps where in his branches, Owl high, Bird in the middle, Squirrel in the hollow, and holds on to all of them till morning.
inspiration: The Mitten (folk) and Andersen's The Fir Tree, turned: the tree does not wish to be elsewhere; being everyone's home is exactly what he wants.
lesson: A home is made by making room.

en-US.title: Tree Finds Room for Everyone
en-US.text: {sfx:wind} [softly] The wind was up. Whoo… whoo… Every leaf on Tree {tree:wobble x3} was dancing, and everyone wanted a bed out of the wind. Which branch for whom? Owl {owl:fade-in} arrived first. I like it high, he said. Then high it is, said Tree, and Owl settled on the very top branch, where he could see the moon. Bird {bird:hop} came next, ruffled. I like it in the middle, where the leaves are thick. Then middle it is. Squirrel {squirrel:hop x2} came last, tail blown sideways. [giggles] I like it… inside! Inside? said Tree. Then he remembered the little hollow by his heart. In you go. {squirrel:fade-out 1.5s} Snug. The wind blew harder. {tree:wobble x2} Tree held on tight to all of them. Top, middle, inside. {sfx:rustle solo} [whispers] Everybody cosy? Everybody cosy. [happily] And Tree stood there all night, in the wind, being a home. Which is what he liked best.

es-ES.title: Árbol tiene sitio para todos
es-ES.text: {sfx:wind} [softly] Hacía viento. Fuuu… fuuu… Todas las hojas de Árbol {tree:wobble x3} bailaban, y todos querían una cama sin viento. ¿Qué rama para quién? Búho {owl:fade-in} llegó el primero. A mí me gusta arriba, dijo. Pues arriba, dijo Árbol, y Búho se acomodó en la rama más alta, desde donde veía la luna. Pájaro {bird:hop} llegó después, despeinado. A mí me gusta en medio, donde las hojas son espesas. Pues en medio. Ardilla {squirrel:hop x2} llegó la última, con la cola de lado. [giggles] A mí me gusta… ¡dentro! ¿Dentro?, dijo Árbol. Y entonces se acordó del huequito que tenía junto al corazón. Pasa. {squirrel:fade-out 1.5s} Calentita. El viento sopló más fuerte. {tree:wobble x2} Árbol los sujetó bien a todos. Arriba, en medio, dentro. {sfx:rustle solo} [whispers] ¿Todos a gusto? Todos a gusto. [happily] Y Árbol pasó la noche entera al viento, siendo una casa. Que era lo que más le gustaba.

wind.prompt: a blustery but friendly night wind through big trees, steady and soft, no howling

rustle.prompt: a big tree's leaves rustling all together in a gust and then settling
